rows.quote_en: As a rule, reports can be received 24 hours a day. PMDA carries out receipt processing as needed after receiving reports and returns an ACK file; reports received during system maintenance periods are processed after the maintenance ends and an ACK file is returned. System maintenance periods are normally from 0:00 to 6:00 on PMDA business days and on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays, but maintenance may be carried out at other times as necessary. [page 50] (2) Receipt of CD etc. reports or paper reports at the counter: As a rule, these are accepted from 9:30 to 17:00 on PMDA business days. Where, for unavoidable reasons such as traffic conditions, arrival after 17:00 is expected, they are accepted until 17:45 only if the Information Management Division, Office of Safety Information and Planning Management, PMDA has been contacted in advance. (3) E-mail reports: As a rule, these can be received 24 hours a day. PMDA processes e-mails received between 9:30 and 17:00 on business days as received that day. E-mails received after 17:00 are treated as received on the next PMDA business day.

rows.quote_en: Where electronic reporting temporarily cannot be performed owing to a system failure etc. and a paper report is made instead, inform the Review Planning Division, Office of Review Management, PMDA of this at the time of the paper report. rows.quote: 市販後副作用等報告に用いる医薬品コードについては、事前に登録又は発行申請が必要である。 （１）から（４）の登録又は発行申請は、FAX 等により PMDA 安全性情報・企画管理部情報管理課へ連絡すること。（１）医療用医薬品の場合報告に係る医薬品について、承認後、 「医療用医薬品データファイル（コード表） 」（再審査用コード）が付されるまでの間は、 「第一次情報源により報告された医薬品名（G.k.2.2）」及び「成分／特定成分名（G.k.2.3.r.1）」に、暫定コードとして治験 55 成分記号を記載すること。当該治験成分記号について、治験計画届を提出していない場合は、別紙９「暫定コード登録票」を用いて暫定コードとして登録すること。治験計画届を提出している場合は、暫定コードの登録は不要であり、治験計画届に記載した治験成分記号を暫定コードとして報告書に記載すること。（２）一般用医薬品および要指導医薬品の場合報告に係る医薬品が「医薬品銘柄コード」に収載されていない場合は、事前に厚生労働省医政局経済課に「医薬品銘柄コード」を登録し、その登録したコードを別紙９を用いて登録すること。（３）体外診断用医薬品又は薬局製造販売医薬品の場合体外診断用医薬品又は薬局製造販売医薬品の副作用等報告用コードは PMDA が発行する。報告に係る体外診断用医薬品のコードが付与されていない場合は、別紙 10「体外診断用医薬品等報告用コード申請票」を用いて事前に当該コードの発行を申請すること。発行したコードは、コード申請者に FAX 等により連絡する。（４）医薬部外品・化粧品の場合医薬部外品及び化粧品の製品コードは PMDA が発行する。報告に係る製品コードが付与されていない場合は、別紙 11「医薬部外品・化粧品製品コード申請票」を用いて当該コードの発行を申請すること。発行したコードは、コード申請者に FAX 等により連絡する。コードを発行済の製品について、重複してコードの発行を申請しないよう注意すること。

rows.quote_en: Drug codes used in post-marketing adverse reaction reports require prior registration or an application for issue. For (1) to (4), contact the PMDA Information Management Division by fax etc. (1) Prescription drugs: until the re-exam code is assigned after approval, enter the investigational ingredient code as a provisional code in G.k.2.2 and G.k.2.3.r.1. Where no clinical trial notification has been submitted for that code, register it as a provisional code using Form 9 "Provisional code registration form"; where one has been submitted, no registration is required and the investigational ingredient code in the notification is entered as the provisional code. (2) Non-prescription and guidance-mandatory drugs: where the drug is not listed in the "drug brand code", register it in advance with the Economic Affairs Division, Health Policy Bureau, MHLW, and register that code using Form 9. (3) In vitro diagnostics or pharmacy-manufactured drugs: PMDA issues the codes for adverse reaction reports; where none has been assigned, apply in advance using Form 10 "Code application form for reports on in vitro diagnostics etc."; the code is notified to the applicant by fax etc. (4) Quasi-drugs and cosmetics: PMDA issues product codes; where none has been assigned, apply using Form 11 "Product code application form for quasi-drugs and cosmetics"; the code is notified by fax etc. Take care not to apply in duplicate for a product already given a code.

rows.quote_en: A. Where "AR" is entered in "ACK.A.4 Transmission acknowledgement code" among the ACK message items, the reports for all cases in that batch have not been accepted; correct the content and resubmit. B. Where "CR" is entered in "ACK.B.r.6 Acknowledgement code for an ICSR message", this indicates that the report could not be accepted; correct the content and resend. Even where "CA" is entered in "ACK.B.r.6 Acknowledgement code for an ICSR message", if an error code is entered in "ACK.B.r.7 Error/warning message or comment", the report has been accepted but contains errors; correct the content and make a follow-up report. C. Error codes are entered in "ACK.B.r.7 Error/warning message or comment"; where there are several errors, up to 20 are entered separated by commas ",". Where there are 20 or more errors, the number of errors that could not be included in "ACK.B.r.7 Error/warning message or comment" is entered at the end in 3 digits; where it cannot be expressed in 3 digits, "999" is entered.

rows.location: 別添10 ICSRファイルの作成等に関する技術的事項 6.(3)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: score below 90: list of unacceptable files without its heading (lead-in missing); authority-side rule. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: A. Files with parse errors. B. Files with invalid file names (files that violate the file name rules shown in Annex 7, item 4, for attached materials, or in Annex 10, item 5, for ICSR files). C. Files with invalid formats (for attached materials, formats other than those shown in Annex 7, 1.(5); for ICSR files, files other than xml or enc format).
